method: Unprofiled source-mode physical typing runs at 5 Hz. Latency is actual character_due timestamp to the first physically acknowledged complete offer containing that character; scheduling delay is measured separately. Each row is one run. Desktop acceptance is functional evidence, not a controlled throughput measurement.
